headline: dtx_gate is implemented as approved and all 90 CPU checks pass. It does webrtcvad DTX gating (mode 1-3, 10/20/30 ms frames, forward hangover 40-200 ms) with an exact-zero or order-10 LPC comfort-noise fill, on the B4 rng4 stream between NS and the codec. With --aug_dtx_p 0.0 the base B3 augmenter is returned unchanged and webrtcvad is never imported. The projected loader cost is about 1.00 against a 1.05 bar.

levers.deviations: No change to the mechanism. Choices the plan left open, and additions: (1) The hangover is applied per sample (round(hang_ms x 16) samples), so U(40,200) ms holds exactly at every frame size. The 5 ms raised-cosine fades lie inside the gated runs, so kept audio is bit-identical; clip edges are not faded. (2) The CNG level is the RMS of the gated samples; the LPC uses the masked autocorrelation plus a 1e-6 white-noise correction on lag 0; stability is checked with np.roots; digital silence falls back to flat noise; 512 warm-up samples are discarded. (3) The autocorrelation lags use elementwise sums instead of np.dot. np.dot wakes numpy's multi-threaded, busy-waiting OpenBLAS, which raised the measured cost of one call from 0.007 to 0.055 CPU-s. The numbers are the same up to rounding. (4) Bin edges, which the plan only names: dtx_g0 < 1 %, dtx_g1_20 [1, 20) %, dtx_g20_40 [20, 40) %, dtx_g40p >= 40 %. (5) The selftest adds two asserts to the plan's four: speech_kept and cng_colour (the LPC colour is what separates our CNG from the held-out white CNG). The selftest also prints a 'B4 DTX gate selftest: PASS ...' line, as apm_ns does; it does not match the expect_regex. (6) dtx_balance reads '200+200' as 200 bona + 200 spoof (the plan says 'per class'). It uses two conditions, the loaded clip and after the B3 acoustic stage, and adds a forced-mode breakdown. (7) b4_dsp_slices.py now prints the plan's report-only VAD-by-fill reading for dtx_gate; the verdict rules are unchanged. data.py needed no change.

equivalence_argument: With --aug_dtx_p 0.0 (the default), active_levers(args) does not contain dtx_gate. If no other B4 lever is on, build_rtc_augmenter_b4 returns build_rtc_augmenter_b3(args), the B3 object itself (checks augmenter: levers_off_returns_b3_object). b4_config_from_args reads a lever's arg_fields only when that lever is on, so --aug_dtx_fill is never read (check dtx_fill_unread_when_p0: an invalid fill with p=0 still gives the B3 object). _init_dtx_gate runs only for active levers, so webrtcvad and b4wave.dsp_dtx are never imported (checks imports, fresh process). The lever's meta keys, describe suffix and header line are added only when it is on (checks flags: levers_off_on_base_argv, no header lines). No rng4 is created or drawn from: rng4 exists only inside lever code, and the forced B4 augmenter without levers keeps rng4 None. When dtx_gate is on, every draw comes from rng4. The identity-gate test shows the parent rng's stage and codec draws, the outputs and the parent counts are bit-identical to B3 at dtx_p=1.0, with and without the codec. The real-gate test shows the parent counts are identical. The model, optimizer, state_dict keys and log formats are untouched. The trainer's only differences are the lever's header and selftest lines and the per-class telemetry, all printed only when a lever is on. The B4 group's new argparse entries do not change any b3wave argument (checks flags: parser_reproduces_b3wave_on_base_argv).
open_issues: Dose: webrtcvad keeps its own overhang of about 100-330 ms after speech, and the plan's 40-200 ms hangover adds to it. On real training clips the realised gated fraction is low: mean about 0.05 per processed clip, and 10-25 % of processed clips gate nothing (the dtx_g0 bin). The held-out vad_gate gates a median 0.126 (mean 0.23) of a clip (data/dev_noisy_sim/heldout_v1/meta.csv). At p=0.3 only about 1.5 % of training audio is gated, so the mechanism may be too weak to move the VAD contrast or criterion (ii). Implemented as approved; whether to change the dose is a plan question for the owner or reviewer.

LOC: lever code is about 300 code lines (dsp_dtx.py 228, of which ~100 are selftest; augment ~35; train ~10; readout ~25), above the plan's est_loc of 210 but under the 400 cap. The checks add 329 more.

Not run here (left to the supervisor): the GPU check 'checks gpu' (generic, covers dtx_gate automatically) and the smoke run. Smoke expectations: header regex; Σ wrtc_dtx_* / Σ codec:* should be about 0.29-0.35 (the toy run had 14/40 on a tiny sample); at least one non-dtx_g0 bin > 0; both classes in the gated bins; timing ≈ 1.00.
Side note: numpy's bundled OpenBLAS (64 threads, busy-wait) makes any np.dot on long vectors in a loader worker cost about 8x its CPU. dtx_gate avoids it; the base pipeline was not examined.
